name: Murtazali Magomedov
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: An unbeaten Kyrgyz featherweight (11-0, age 27; 1-0 UFC; about 180 cm) and former Octagon League champion who has finished every opponent: five KO/TKOs and six submissions. He won his contract with a 97-second TKO on the 2025 Contender Series and submitted Melsik Baghdasaryan with a twister in 77 seconds on his UFC debut, earning a bonus.

how_they_fight.Striking: Has knockout power (five KO/TKO wins). Dropped Brahyam Zurcher with a jab on the Contender Series and finished with punches at 1:37 of R1. Little UFC tape: 14 significant strikes landed across his two UFC-promoted fights.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Scrambler and back-taker. He took Baghdasaryan down when Baghdasaryan got too aggressive, hooked both legs, rolled to the back and locked up a modified twister he'd learned from Askar Askarov a month before (Cageside Press). Six submission wins, four in R1. Describes himself as rounded: 'I know wrestling, I know striking' (UFC.com).
how_they_fight.Defense: Never lost, never been to a decision, so almost nothing is known about how he handles being hurt or behind.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A very fast starter, but not only that. Of 11 finishes, seven came in R1, two in R2 and two in R3 (a TKO and a submission). He has never gone 15 minutes, and the deepest he has gone is about 13 minutes. Three of his wins came on one night in a 2022 regional grand prix.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident and opportunistic; capitalises immediately on an opponent's mistake. Wants to fight every three to four months; his debut came about nine months after earning his contract.

patterns: Punishes aggression with a takedown and a back take
Has finished in R3 twice, so the threat doesn't disappear late
concerns: Never been past R3 or to the judges
Only 2:54 of UFC-promoted cage time in total
Record differs by source: Esporte News Mundo said ten wins; our data and Cageside have 11-0
keys_to_beat: Don't overcommit to exchanges or shots early; he punishes mistakes
Drag him into R3 with volume and see how he holds up

news.text: Debuted with a twister submission of Melsik Baghdasaryan at 1:17 of R1 and a Performance of the Night bonus.
Said Askar Askarov showed him the twister about a month before the fight.
